business: ShapeKraft RFQ Launch Kit: a catalogue website plus an enquiry-to-quote desk, set up and run monthly for Indian B2B traders and distributors
target: Owners of Indian B2B trading and distribution firms (chemicals, industrial supplies, packaging, textiles) who get buyer enquiries (RFQs) by IndiaMART, phone and WhatsApp and send quotes by hand
where: India, mainly industrial and trading hubs in Maharashtra and Gujarat; all money amounts are in Indian rupees (INR), not dollars

segments.name: Owner of a micro trading firm, 1-5 staff (NOTE: the yearly figure below is the firm's annual turnover in Indian rupees, not dollars)
Owner of a small trader-manufacturer, 5-20 staff (NOTE: the yearly figure below is the firm's annual turnover in Indian rupees, not dollars)
Owner or director of an established distributor, 20-50 staff (NOTE: the yearly figure below is the firm's annual turnover in Indian rupees, not dollars)

behaviours.name: IndiaMART-dependent
behaviours.how: Pays for an IndiaMART membership and gets most new enquiries from it; replies from the phone app.

behaviours.name: Phone-and-WhatsApp old school
behaviours.how: Quotes from memory or an Excel price list over calls and WhatsApp; most business is repeat buyers.

behaviours.name: Burned before
behaviours.how: Paid a web developer or a portal before and got little back; suspicious of digital promises.

behaviours.name: Hard negotiator
behaviours.how: Bargains on every purchase and compares at least three quotes before paying anyone.

behaviours.name: Next-generation modernizer
behaviours.how: A son, daughter or young partner pushing the family firm to go digital; reads up on tools.

behaviours.name: Asks the CA first
behaviours.how: Runs any spend above a few thousand rupees past their chartered accountant.

objections: IndiaMART already gives me a catalogue and enquiries
Rs 60,000 plus Rs 5,000 every month is a lot for a website
My prices change daily and by customer, an automatic quote will be wrong
I paid for leads before and they were fake, why trust another digital promise
My staff and I can reply on WhatsApp ourselves
Who maintains it if this small studio disappears
A website alone will not bring buyers
habits: you check new enquiries on your phone first thing every morning
your price list is an Excel file that changes when raw material rates move
most of your orders come from repeat buyers who call you directly
you get somewhere between 5 and 40 new enquiries a week
your nephew built your current website years ago and nobody updates it
you lost an order last month because another supplier quoted first
